description_en: Queries the custom domain names that are bound to projects
description_zh: 列出Project绑定的自定义域名
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-domains --project ali-test-project --offset 0 --size 10 --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDomains

parameters.description_en: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0.
parameters.description_zh: 分页查询开始的位置。默认值为0。
parameters.help_en: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询开始的位置。默认值为0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 500. Maximum value: 500.
parameters.description_zh: 分页查询时，设置的每页行数。默认值为500，最大值为500。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 500. Maximum value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置的每页行数。默认值为500，最大值为500
parameters.name: size

parameters.description_en: The domain name that is used to match custom domain names. For example, if you set domainName to `example.com`, the matched domain names are `a.example.com` and `b.example.com`.
parameters.description_zh: 用于匹配自定义域名，例如`example.com`会匹配到`a.example.com`与`b.example.com`。
parameters.help_en: The domain name that is used to match custom domain names. For example, if you set domainName to `example.com`, the matched domain names are `a.example.com` and `b.example.com`
parameters.help_zh: 用于匹配自定义域名，例如`example.com`会匹配到`a.example.com`与`b.example.com`
parameters.name: domain_name
